logp.method_description: This property was measured by following well-established shake-flask methods in a non-miscible n-octanol/water. The concentrations of the complexes Ru-anth and Ru-biot (ca. 26 uM, in 0.26% DMSO/water) were initially measured in water using a UV-vis spectrophotometer, and later mixed with an equal volume of n-octanol. This mixture was stirred for 24 h in the dark at 25 C, and centrifuged to achieve better phase separation. The aqueous layer was collected and its spectrum taken. The concentration of these complexes in water was measured using standard curves (ABS vs. concentration), where the concentration in the n-octanol layer was calculated by the difference of the concentration found in the aqueous layer.
